scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); for(const f of ['index.html','chat-ui-enhancements.js','chat-widget.js','profile-ui.js','push-ui.js','account-updates.js','pwa-init.js','sw.js','manifest.webmanifest','withdrawal-ui.js','activity-ui.js','whatsapp-channel.js','admin-monitoring-ui.js','admin-order-controls.js','rating-ui.js']) if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/'+f); if(fs.existsSync('icons')) fs.cpSync('icons','dist/icons',{recursive:true}); let p=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html','utf8'); for(const f of ['profile-ui.js','push-ui.js','account-updates.js','pwa-init.js','withdrawal-ui.js','activity-ui.js','whatsapp-channel.js','admin-monitoring-ui.js','admin-order-controls.js','rating-ui.js']) if(!p.includes('/'+f)) p=p.replace('</body>','<script src=\"/'+f+'\"></script>\n</body>'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.html',p); console.log('SALGA Digital Mart Netlify build ready')"
